fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-03-04 at about 21:25, it was reported that unidentified persons allegedly damaged a parked car of the complainant near Roja Colony Residential Colony at night. Contact details given by the complainant, Priya Raman, include the number 9000000378. A witness, Ramesh Pandian, reachable on 9000000469, was mentioned in the complaint. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. A car bearing the number TN-58-YY-1037 was seen leaving the area. The complainant mentioned photographs and a vehicle observation. This matter may be connected to FIR-2026-00153, where the same vehicle registration TN-58-YY-1037 was also mentioned.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night. A car was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, residential colony, witness, car, photograph, night, vehicle observation
